info.description:
API for exploring AI conversation traces from Claude Code, Kimi Code, and other sources.

## Authentication

The API supports Bearer token authentication. When `THINKT_API_TOKEN` environment variable
is set or `--token` flag is provided, all requests must include the token in the
Authorization header:

Authorization: Bearer <token>

Generate a secure token with: `thinkt server token`

parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Roles to exclude (repeat query param or comma-separated). Defaults to checkpoint.

content_blocks.description: Content (one of these will be set)

source.description: Provenance - where this entry came from

path_exists.description: Whether the project directory still exists on disk

lead_agent_id.description: LeadAgentID is the config-format agent ID (e.g., "team-lead@myteam").

lead_session_id.description:
LeadSessionID is the UUID of the team lead's session.
Subagent sessions live under projects/{projectDir}/{LeadSessionID}/subagents/

name.description: Name is the team identifier (directory name under ~/.claude/teams/).
Name is the short display name (e.g., "researcher").

session_path.description:
SessionPath is the path to this member's subagent JSONL file.
Populated during discovery. Empty for unresolved members.

source_agent_id.description:
SourceAgentID is the short hash used in session JSONL entries
(e.g., "ab17e07"). Populated when correlating team config with
session data. May be empty if not yet resolved.
